title: Still Kicking (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 104bpm walking bass brushed drums resilience character portrait true story Australian family honest unhurried
lyrics:
[Intro - acoustic guitar, slow and steady]
November 2021.
He was in the right place.
Security said he was in the wrong place.
Wrong is the wrong word for it.

[Verse 1]
It came from nowhere
The way coward punches come
He was a happy man at an event
Not a threat to anyone
The old and frail were there
Young mums with babies
Joel was the one strong enough
To take it and not fall apart

[Verse 2]
Concussion first
Then they found the neck
The nerve had been pinched for years
The punch just told them where to look
Pins and needles down the left arm
Numb fingers in the cold
Operation on the neck
And Silver Chain every morning
And the long way back

[Chorus]
Still kicking
He answered that when they asked
Still kicking
From Brazil, Corey called
Still kicking
Joel on the other end of the line
Still kicking
Neck is coming good
Still kicking
The man who took the hit
Is still here
Still kicking

[Bridge - spoken, level]
He went to see a psychologist.
He said that.
In a text.
To his brother.
The kind of man who can do that
Is not the kind of man
Who gets beaten by a coward punch.
He will live.
He always said so.
And the bricks are still in the driveway.
And Oma said breathe when you sing.
He was trying.
He just couldn't.
Now he can.

[Verse 3]
He got the nose fixed too
Left side was always the trouble
Now he can breathe again
And Oma's rule applies
And Kerri is cancer free
And the family came through
One thing at a time
The way families always do
One thing at a time

[Chorus reprise]
Still kicking
Joel Aaron McIvor
Still kicking
First grade, rugby-trained, upright
Still kicking
The answer was always yes
Still kicking
Still kicking

[Outro - guitar fading]
The call came from Brazil
You alive?
Still kicking
You alive?
Yes
